selection_rule: For each change type, process completed scenes in batch-id order and use a deterministic balanced random cycle. Select 8 unique renderable questions per scene, prioritizing templates not yet used in the current 60-template cycle. Eight scenes therefore cover every template at least once when all 60 templates are renderable.
answer_policy: Templates 1-40 are descriptive. Templates 41-60 are closed-ended and answer exactly Yes. or No.

camera_path: The camera starts on one side of the table, turns away, walks around the table, reaches the opposite side, and then looks toward the table again.

viewpoint_policy.first_view_left: the left side of the table in the first view
viewpoint_policy.first_view_right: the right side of the table in the first view
viewpoint_policy.second_view_left: the left side of the table in the second view
viewpoint_policy.second_view_right: the right side of the table in the second view

same_physical_place_mapping.the left side of the table in the first: the right side of the table in the second view
same_physical_place_mapping.the right side of the table in the first: the left side of the table in the second view

viewpoint_policy.wording_rule: Use the first view toward the table and the second view toward the table naturally in sentences. Do not use parenthetical view labels or tabletop-state wording.
viewpoint_policy.movement_rule: When an object crosses physical sides, prefer 'moved to the other side of the table'.
viewpoint_policy.reference_rule: Describe left/right directly relative to the table and the relevant view, not relative to another object.
